title: Chemical-enhanced thyroid cell detection using photonic crystal biosensors with phase-change materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10113-10128
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09237J, Paper
Open Access

Walaa M. Nouman, Fatma A. Sayed, Arafa H. Aly, S. E.-S. Abd El-Ghany, Samira M. Sallam
This study proposes a one-dimensional defective photonic crystal (1D-DPC) biosensor based on the phase-change material Ge2Sb2Te5 (GST) for label-free detection of thyroid nodules in the visible range.
